But there are some shocking facts about residential schools in tribal areas. There are regular deaths of adivasi students in these schools due to snake bite or some illness. The parliament ’s standing committee has also submitted a report in 2014 about this issue. But no corrective measures to prevent deaths of Adivasi students are taken.
